item.title: NHL News: Penguins D Kris Letang (foot) out 4 weeks, placed on IR
item.description: Pittsburgh Penguins defenseman Kris Letang is sidelined a minimum of four weeks due to a broken foot, the team said Saturday. Letang, who was placed on injured reserve Saturday, joined forward Evgeni Malkin in missing practice on Friday. item.title: NHL News: Bruins D Jonathan Aspirot signs 2-year contract
item.description: Boston Bruins defenseman Jonathan Aspirot signed a two-year contract worth $1.775 million on Sunday. Aspirot, 26, spent six years in the American Hockey League before making his NHL debut on Oct. 28. He has three points (two goals, one assist) and a team-best rating of plus-15 in 25 games with Boston. –Field Level Media The post NHL News: Bruins D Jonathan Aspirot signs 2-year contract appeared first on CWEB.
